ModMetaData.name: GeneFoundry
ModMetaData.author: Guy Symonds
ModMetaData.description:
Turn organic matter into genetic possibilities.
GeneFoundry adds a three-stage biotechnology chain: extract raw biomass from meat, plants or organic corpses at the Gene Vat; refine it using hopper-fed, processor-assisted machinery; then manufacture selected single- or multi-gene genepacks at the Gene Fabricator.
Features specialist operators: Cooking for extraction, Intellectual for refinement and Crafting for fabrication, corpse stripping and artificial-part salvage, enzymatic extraction, rot-stink incidents, batch failure influenced by skill and room conditions, and a dedicated gene research tree generated from loaded gene categories. Raw extraction guarantees some recovery; failed refinery batches lose their ingredients.
Example: one Green Skin cosmetic genepack After Xenogenetics and Gene fabrication research, use a powered Gene Vat, a Biomass Refinery with an adjacent hopper, and a Gene Fabricator. Green Skin needs 10 refined biomass, no gene sample and no archite capsules. One successful refinery batch supplies it: 45 raw biomass + 1 neutroamine = 10 refined biomass.
At default settings, using BASIC extraction, fresh undamaged corpses, Cooking 10 and normal work speed: - Raw meat: 350 meat (seven 50-meat batches) yields 49 raw biomass; about 9 h 34 min to the first pack. - Raw vegetables/berries: 350 food (seven 50-food batches) yields 49 raw biomass; about 9 h 34 min to the first pack. Wood is excluded. - Human corpse (140 recoverable meat): one yields 46 raw biomass; about 8 h 41 min to the first pack. - Elephant corpse (560 recoverable meat): one yields 184 raw biomass; about 9 h 57 min to the first pack, with enough raw biomass left for three more refinery batches.
These sequential estimates include extraction, 90-minute refinery preparation, 6-hour automated refining with no processors and 40 minutes of fabrication at minimum Crafting 10. Every processor removes 20 refining minutes; 15 reach the 1-hour minimum, cutting five hours from these estimates. Estimates assume successful batches without wastage and exclude hauling, implant recovery and interruptions; better skills can shorten work and reduce failure. Enzymatic extraction can reduce food requirements to 250 meat or plant food + 5 herbal medicine for the same 45 raw biomass.
Requires RimWorld 1.6 or 1.7 and Biotech. No Harmony dependency. Other game versions and mod combinations are not declared supported.
Created by Guy Symonds in collaboration with ChatGPT by OpenAI, with additional development assistance from OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot.
